# EMMana-Next rev31 — antenna-first geometry UX

- Yagi geometry now reads visually as an antenna in XZ: visual boom, reflector/driven/director labels, element lengths, spacing dimensions and feed label.
- User-facing terminology changed from wire to antenna element in the geometry editor.
- Startup template selection now matches the actual loaded EMNX model instead of defaulting to Yagi while a dipole is shown.
- Template catalog has a static fallback copy; stale template parameter panels are hidden when the catalog cannot load.
- Server template loading also falls back to the static registry.
- Physics/solver/EMNX schema unchanged.
